name: Як це називається? Захист
description:
In this lesson, one of you pieces is in danger. If you don't defend it, you'll lose your piece. Like in a real game, it is up to you to figure out how to defend. Pay attention not only to the piece you have to defend, but also to the position. Often you have to defend in such a way that you solve another problem at the same time.

After your move, a question appears, asking you what your defense technique is called. Tick the correct answer.


What do you have to do?

Find the right way to defend your piece and answer the question.
